look.summary_zh: 中性 · 提亮中灰 · 中段拉开
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 130.9/255（变化 +3.4 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.249。中灰红减蓝 -1.0 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #F8E9D4、#E7A87A、#8B4C25；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #F41C22、#01EA02、#2E12E8。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 130.9/255 (+3.4 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.249; mid-gray red minus blue -1.0 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #F8E9D4, #E7A87A, #8B4C25. Red/green/blue swatches: #F41C22, #01EA02, #2E12E8.
look.suggested_use_zh: 产品、生活与风景对照试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
